experiment: Rotated MNIST (1000-image subset per domain, 32x32) with LeNet-5; leave-one-domain-out over rotations 0,15,30,45,60,75; methods ERM, RandMatch, MatchDG, PerfMatch
notes: Each test domain is a separate train.py job: train on the other five rotations, test on the held-out one. The script never computes the 'Average' column; the repo only prints mean and std per job.

train.py prints two numbers per job: 'Source Validation' (test accuracy at the epoch with best source-val accuracy) and 'Target Validation' (max over epochs of test accuracy, i.e. an oracle on the test domain). Which one the paper reports is not determined by the code. Both come with np.std (population SD) over 3 runs.
The script passes --dataset, but train.py defines --dataset_name; argparse prefix abbreviation resolves it. Default dataset_name is already rot_mnist.

Sample counts assume the notebook's --subset_size 1000 (script default is 2000): 1000 train and 200 val images per domain. Test data for domain d reuses the same base images as train (res[:subset_size]), only rotated differently, for the same seed.
Seeds 0,1,2 pick different base MNIST subsets (data_gen seed*10), and run index = mnist_subset in the loader. Training seeds are run*10.

ERM, RandMatch and PerfMatch share the same code (erm_match). The CE loss is computed only on the matched batch (all domains' matched points); the raw batch x_e is not used in the loss. ERM uses penalty_ws=0 with random matches.
In erm_match, penalty_ws ramps as penalty_ws*(epoch+1)/(epochs+1), since penalty_s=-1 and match_flag=0. Penalty distance is l2 on logits (pos_metric default l2, match_layer logit_match).

MatchDG phase 2 (matchdg_erm): loss = CE on matched points + CE on the plain batch + ramp*penalty_ws*l2 logit matching, ramp=(epoch+1)/(epochs+1). Matches are inferred from the phase-1 contrastive model (match_case -1, 100 matches per point); match_flag defaults to 0, so matches are not refreshed.

MatchDG phase 1 trains with only the NT-Xent style contrastive loss (weight ramp (epoch+1)/51), no CE; matches are refreshed every 5 epochs (match_interrupt default 5) with match_flag 1; the checkpoint is chosen every 5 epochs by top-10 perfect-match score on the val data of the source domains, using both augmented and original copies (match_func_aug_case 1). No lr schedule applies in phase 1 (the StepLR scheduler in BaseAlgo is created but never stepped).

The stored augmented copy (RandomResizedCrop scale 0.7-1 plus horizontal flip, applied after rotation) is only read in MatchDG phase 1 for checkpoint selection. All training and evaluation otherwise use the *_org_data.pt files because mnist_aug defaults to 0.

The LR schedule in phase 2 / erm_match for lenet rebuilds SGD at epochs 25, 50, 75 with lr=0.01/2^k, which also resets momentum buffers. The optimizer is SGD momentum 0.9 with nesterov True hard-coded (the --opt flag only switches to Adam).
Test data for lenet uses mnist_subset=run (same as train), not seed 9. 90-degree data is not generated for lenet.
No hyperparameter tuning scripts for this experiment; hyperparameters are fixed in the reproduce script and argparse defaults.
